subject: Error, "Shiny version ' 0.0.0' found. Shiny Server requires at least ' 0.7.0'

messages.author: 9762d2aeadee97e4
messages.subject: Error, "Shiny version ' 0.0.0' found. Shiny Server requires at least ' 0.7.0'
parts:
I've created a fresh installation of Ubuntu 12.04, and followed the instructions for installing. 

The first problem I came across was having a very old version of R (the default that installs in Ubuntu). I then added a CRAN mirror and updates to 3.0.2

Now, I'm getting the error you see above; I'm running version 0.0.0 of Shiny?

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Error, "Shiny version ' 0.0.0' found. Shiny Server requires at least ' 0.7.0'
parts:
Tim,

It seems that Shiny Server is not finding the "Shiny" package. If you have not installed that package, refer to http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#install-shiny for instructions on how to install it. 

Let us know if you continue having problem with this.
Fereshteh

Hello Tim

I have the same problem:

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Error en eval(expr, envir, enclos) : Shiny version ' 0.0.0 ' found. Shiny Server requires at least ' 0.7.0 '. Calls: local -> eval.parent -> eval -> eval -> eval -> eval Ejecución interrumpida


I have: shiny 0.8.0 , Ubuntu 12.04 Precise LTS, Shiny Server v0.4.0.15 , Node.js v0.10.21

I followed the instructions on the page http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#install-shiny  but can not find solution.

You can help me, please?

Thanks

Pablo

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Error, "Shiny version ' 0.0.0' found. Shiny Server requires at least ' 0.7.0'
parts:
Pablo,

Is it possible that "shiny" has been installed at a user level, and not system-wide? Can you please run this command:

sudo su - -c "R -e \"packageVersion('shiny')\""

Also do you see "shiny" in this location:

/usr/local/lib/R/site-library

If these indicate that "shiny" is not installed system-wide, please try installing it again following the instructions.
If it is installed system-wide and you still see the problem after restarting your Shiny Server, please send us your configuration file, and the related log information from /var/log/shiny-server.log (or the whole log file).

Thanks,
Fereshteh

messages.author: abd0c3c3329f14a7
messages.subject: Re: Error, "Shiny version ' 0.0.0' found. Shiny Server requires at least ' 0.7.0'
parts:
Fereshteh

Thanks for the reply. I've Solved the problem:

I had installed the library shiny from RStudio but running it as an unprivileged user. 
The solution is to run the command:

sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""  ( http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#install-shiny)

This command installs the library shiny but as root. After doing this, restart the server shiny-server and now works fine!!

Thanks!!
Pablo
